# Test fixtures

`images/` is served at `/fixtures` by `createTestApp` (see `test/helpers/index.ts`).

| File | Size | What it covers |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `scene-a.png` | 256×192 | The original image. |
| `scene-a-copy.png` | 256×192 | Byte-for-byte copy of `scene-a.png`: duplicates merge into one Media row. |
| `scene-a-small.png` | 128×96 | `scene-a.png` at half size: its own Media row (different bytes), but the same perceptual hash, which near-match will use. |
| `checker-b.jpg` | 40×40 | A different image, and the JPEG path. |
| `not-an-image.png` | - | Text with a `.png` extension: dimensions are `NULL`, and its perceptual hash is `none` (can't be decoded). |
| `transparent-corner.png` | 64×64 | Opaque shapes with one fully transparent quadrant: checks that transparent pixels hash as white, as they did with `image-hash`. |
| `notes.txt` | - | Unsupported file type: skipped by `syncDirectory`. |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `__beidou_genshin_impact_drawn_by_packge__26d9f313e83b566da8a9116ec71be5d4.jpg` | 2480 x 3508 | A real JPG sample. |
| `Roxanne.webp` | 700 x 1124 | Real WebP sample. |
| `amberlyn.jpg` | 1920 x 2640 | Real JPG sample. |
| `2148362390_preview_success-small-flip.gif` | 160 x 137 | GIF sample. |
| `1337.jpg` | 2287 x 3810 | JPG sample. |
| `RsniFBN.mp4` | - | mp4 sample. |
| `image-variant-1.jpg` | 2605 x 4096 | real example of a variant set to test the image hash. |
| `image-variant-2.jpg` | 2605 x 4096 | the variant to the previous image. |
| `image-variant-1-resized.jpg` | 850 x 1337 | a resized version of `image-variant-1`. |

The images in the first section were generated by Claude. The resized copy only keeps the same perceptual hash because both sizes split evenly into the 16×16 hash grid; a 64×48 copy, for example, doesn't merge. If you replace these files, update the tests that depend on them, and regenerate `goldenHashes.ts` (see its header).
The images in the second section are real images chosen to represent the kind of images that the app will be used for, and for file type and test case coverage.
